phase_3.void_description: 00 — No dialects enumerated, the empty set before any gate threshold assignment

phase_3.both_description: 11 — A dialect simultaneously passes and fails gate thresholds (paradice), held without resolution

steps.domain_action: Initialize the empty dialect enumeration space with zero dialects
Self-reference the canonical grammar that defines all possible dialects
Split the dialect specification into three gate threshold positions (G1, G2, G3)
Evaluate Gate 1 threshold — affirmative branch where the dialect meets the threshold
Evaluate Gate 1 threshold — negative branch where the dialect fails the threshold
Hold the paradice state where a dialect both passes and fails simultaneously
Fuse the three gate evaluations back into the single dialect identity
Chain the sequential gate evaluations across all three positions
Permanently record the dialect configuration in ROM as an append-only entry
Anchor the canonical dialect U0 that bounds the complete grammar space
